enemies.name: Mud Reedback
enemies.telegraph: Pulls into its shell before a shove.
enemies.counter: Use magic or guard the announced shove.

enemies.name: Reed Hound
enemies.telegraph: Lowers its head before a lunge.
enemies.counter: Remove a pack member early.

enemies.name: Soot Wisp
enemies.telegraph: Gathers sparks before spreading.
enemies.counter: Area damage reduces the swarm's later actions.

enemies.name: Brass Mite
enemies.telegraph: Opens a vent to ready a piercing jab.
enemies.counter: Strike while its mechanism is exposed.

enemies.name: Salt Jackal
enemies.telegraph: Watches the lowest-HP hero before its next attack.
enemies.counter: Heal the threatened hero or guard.

enemies.name: Coin Moth
enemies.telegraph: Reflective wings flare before a dust burst.
enemies.counter: Favor reliable magical damage.

enemies.name: Ledger Sentinel
enemies.telegraph: Locks its shutters while supporting a caster.
enemies.counter: Attack the fragile caster first.

enemies.name: Wax Cantor
enemies.telegraph: Inflates a wax throat before a silence attempt.
enemies.counter: Prioritize it or prepare status recovery.

enemies.name: Reed Widow
enemies.telegraph: Raises its marked forelegs before a venom strike.
enemies.counter: Protect the marked hero or cure poison.

enemies.name: Bog Reedback
enemies.telegraph: Plants its shell before a sweeping ram.
enemies.counter: Guard the announced heavy attack.

enemies.name: Mourning Cantor
enemies.telegraph: A visible throat-ring brightens before a lullaby.
enemies.counter: Defeat it before it supports the formation.

enemies.name: Fen Hound
enemies.telegraph: Circles a guarded hero, then chooses another.
enemies.counter: Avoid relying on one protected tank.

enemies.name: Thorn Spinner
enemies.telegraph: Weaves a dark knot before firing.
enemies.counter: Use protection or focus fire.

enemies.name: Cinder Hart
enemies.telegraph: Antlers brighten before a charge.
enemies.counter: Guard, then exploit its recovery.

enemies.name: Orchard Wisp
enemies.telegraph: Draws sparks toward a root before bursting.
enemies.counter: Use area attacks to reduce the group.

enemies.name: Husk Hound
enemies.telegraph: Scrapes the ground before attacking a wounded target.
enemies.counter: Stabilize the threatened hero's HP.

enemies.name: Road Bellwarden
enemies.telegraph: Turns its shield toward an ally before covering it.
enemies.counter: Change targets or use magic.

enemies.name: Mirror Reedback
enemies.telegraph: Raises reflective shell plates before a physical slam.
enemies.counter: Guard the slam; its shell is not a magic-reflect effect.

enemies.name: Gallows Cantor
enemies.telegraph: Its hanging throat-loop glows before the chant.
enemies.counter: Keep silence recovery available.

enemies.name: Antler Pilgrim
enemies.telegraph: Kneels before a heavy sweep.
enemies.counter: Preserve protection for the telegraphed round.

enemies.name: Crown Sentinel
enemies.telegraph: Opens shoulder vents before its shield slam.
enemies.counter: Attack during its recovery.

enemies.name: Ink Widow
enemies.telegraph: Spreads its striped legs before marking a target.
enemies.counter: Prioritize it or guard the marked hero.

enemies.name: Glass Wisp
enemies.telegraph: Prisms align before a party-wide pulse.
enemies.counter: Reduce the group quickly.

enemies.name: Choir Shade
enemies.telegraph: Its throat-rings light in sequence.
enemies.counter: Defeat it before it supports the formation.

rares.name: Silver Reedback
rares.telegraph: Silver chevron shell withdraws before a powerful shove.
rares.counter: Guard the shove and strike during recovery.

rares.name: Coinveil Jackal
rares.telegraph: Coin-shaped spots flare before a committed lunge.
rares.counter: Distinguish the visible lunge tell from its feint.

rares.name: Moonlace Widow
rares.telegraph: Crescent legs point at the next venom target.
rares.counter: Protect that hero and prepare poison recovery.

rares.name: Amberglass Hart
rares.telegraph: Amber antlers brighten before a sweeping charge.
rares.counter: Guard the sweep and use the reset to recover.

rares.name: Ivory Bellwarden
rares.telegraph: Black handprints meet as the ivory plates brace.
rares.counter: Prepare during the defended assault, then attack the exposed core.

rares.name: Starless Cantor
rares.telegraph: White throat-rings light before alternating chants.
rares.counter: Use its announced recovery window and keep silence recovery ready.

bosses.name: Brass Bailiff
bosses.telegraph: Hammer rises with a warning note before a heavy strike.
bosses.counter: Guard, then attack external joints during recovery.
bosses.story_outcome: Break the binding frame and rescue Orren alive; his body is not a target.

bosses.name: Toll Collector
bosses.telegraph: Shutters rotate between protection and an exposed mechanism.
bosses.counter: Prepare during the armored round and strike its opening.
bosses.story_outcome: Free the holding yard by disabling the machine; no captive is inside it.

bosses.name: Silt Crown
bosses.telegraph: Floating debris forms a crown before a sweeping surge.
bosses.counter: Guard the surge, then use fire against the exposed Hush growth.
bosses.story_outcome: Open the flooded granary's existing food stores and supply route.

bosses.name: Ashroot Hart
bosses.telegraph: Roots darken before poison; antlers brighten before its charge.
bosses.counter: Keep poison recovery ready and exploit the pause after a charge.
bosses.story_outcome: Secure the orchard route and clean storehouse; soil does not instantly heal.

bosses.name: Gate-Censer
bosses.telegraph: Its armored bowl closes before a silencing chime.
bosses.counter: Use physical attackers and recovery supplies, then strike the exposed stem.
bosses.story_outcome: Open a regional feeder approach for captive rescue and supported handover.

bosses.name: Night Choir
bosses.telegraph: Three sets of throat-rings identify the next chant.
bosses.counter: Focus one singer while reserving protection and silence recovery.
bosses.story_outcome: Open the final service stairwell for the rear guard.

bosses.name: Vale's Command Armor
bosses.telegraph: Armor braces before a crushing order.
bosses.counter: Guard and break external control braces.
bosses.story_outcome: Extract Vale alive for judgment; victory does not pardon him.

bosses.name: Heart Bell
bosses.telegraph: Resonance vanes visibly align before its strongest pulse.
bosses.counter: Guard and conserve recovery through shield cycles.
bosses.story_outcome: Stop the last active captive-fed bell after the evacuation preparations.

bosses.name: Briar Widow
bosses.telegraph: Raised forelegs repeat the venom warning seen on damaged stems.
bosses.counter: Protect the marked hero and cure poison.
bosses.story_outcome: Recover Jessa's optional graft in SQ-R3 without affecting evacuation food.

bosses.name: Unlit Colossus
bosses.telegraph: Quarry lamps outline its raised drill arm before an immense slam.
bosses.counter: Prepare protection and exploit the long mechanical reset.
bosses.story_outcome: Defeat an optional post-campaign testing construct; it is not the fog's cause.
